title.zh: Hello Python 3.15, goodbye 3.10, and now I can use 3.11
title.en: Hello Python 3.15, goodbye 3.10, and now I can use 3.11

current_state.zh: Python 3.15 has been released with highlights including PEP 810 explicit lazy imports, and the annual version cycle means Python 3.10 reaches end of support as developers begin adopting 3.11 features.
current_state.en: Python 3.15 has been released with highlights including PEP 810 explicit lazy imports, and the annual version cycle means Python 3.10 reaches end of support as developers begin adopting 3.11 features.
